General and Subject TALPers

Reading TALPer

Reading TALPer | Find evidence and explain your thinking

The Reading TALPer provides grade-appropriate texts aligned with Taiwan’s 12-Year Basic Education Curriculum Guidelines. Through guided dialogue, students retrieve information, interpret meaning and make inferences to understand the text. They compare perspectives and integrate ideas to develop independent critical thinking. The process makes reading more engaging, builds confidence and helps students become thoughtful, discerning readers.

Example: Taiwan’s Hongye youth baseball story

Writing TALPer

Writing TALPer | Turn experiences and feelings into writing

When students ask for an essay, the Writing TALPer first uses questions and guidance to draw out their own ideas. 1. The student presents a writing request. 2. TALPer guides the student to choose a direction. 3. Follow-up questions elicit more specific details. 4. The student confirms the direction before TALPer develops the text from those ideas.

Example: My most unforgettable class

Learning Support TALPer

Learning Support TALPer | Small steps and encouragement

Designed for students who need additional support, this TALPer uses a slower pace. It combines intelligent tutoring, precision teaching and gamified learning through structured, step-by-step dialogue. Students build subject knowledge and problem-solving strategies while practicing how to express their ideas. Warm emotional support is central: short exchanges, a friendly tone and encouragement to try without fearing mistakes help strengthen participation and learning confidence.

Example: A NT$200 shirt at 20% off

Art TALPer

Art TALPer | Plan a composition and express ideas visually

When students request an image, TALPer first asks questions to help them articulate their visual ideas. 1. The student presents an idea or request. 2. TALPer elicits elements such as people, setting and color. 3. Follow-up questions refine the details. 4. The student confirms the artistic direction before TALPer generates the image.

Example: Austronesian ancestors setting sail from Taiwan

Science Inquiry TALPer

Science Inquiry TALPer | Predict, explain and make judgments

TALPer’s responses and questions follow the 5E inquiry learning cycle to guide students’ learning. 1. Engagement 2. Exploration 3. Explanation 4. Elaboration 5. Evaluation

Example: Friction when pushing a book and a table

SRL TALPer

SRL TALPer | Set goals, monitor and adjust

Before learning, the TALPer guides students to set goals and select strategies. Students then work through a learning unit with TALPer. Afterward, TALPer guides them to monitor and evaluate their learning, then make appropriate adjustments.

Example: Introduce Tainan beef soup in three English sentences

Cognitive Diagnosis TALPer

Cognitive Diagnosis TALPer | Identify gaps and target support

The aim is to identify where students get stuck. The TALPer maps mixed-skill questions to three skills and applies a nonparametric cognitive diagnosis model to assess mastery of each skill. It then provides personalized support for skills not yet mastered, giving practice a clear focus and helping students overcome learning difficulties.

Example: A probability problem involving ten coin tosses

Interactive TALPer

Interactive TALPer | Make abstract concepts tangible

Through dialogue, the TALPer helps students express their ideas and difficulties, revealing conceptual gaps. It uses Vibe Coding to create an interactive tool tailored to their learning needs. Guided manipulation, observation and verification make abstract concepts visible, helping students revise misconceptions and overcome learning barriers through exploration.

Example: The centered form of a high-school cubic function

Teacher-Built TALPer

Teacher-Built TALPer | Turn teaching expertise into an AI TALPer

Teachers turn subject expertise and teaching strategies into prompts and upload course materials. Without writing code, they create a dedicated TALPer matched to students’ levels and learning needs. They can assign it to individuals, groups or the whole class, extending professional teaching guidance into differentiated learning support.

Example: A course on Taiwan and Austronesian history and culture

Teaching Material Designer

Teaching Material Designer | Teacher-led, AI-assisted handouts

Teachers’ professional judgment guides the process. They enter the subject, topic and learner level, then work with TALPer to adjust content depth, scaffolding and task difficulty to students’ prior knowledge and learning needs. Teachers guide, review and revise throughout the process (human in the loop), turning AI-generated content into an eight-page handout for differentiated instruction.

Example: Junior-high mathematics materials on parabolas

Analytics and Data Literacy

Analytics Applications, AI-Enabled Insights, and Data Literacy Training

Target: Educational decision-makers (including officials in education bureaus, school principals, and directors).

Content: Capabilities in data interpretation, analytical application, and AI-assisted analysis.

Direction: Optimizing dashboard indicators and visualization while integrating Generative AI with locally distinctive datasets.

Goal: Promoting the practical application of educational data in administrative decision-making and classroom instruction.
